query_text: 想找一家停车很方便的餐厅，附近最好有免费停车场，有推荐吗？
requirement_text: 评论需要说明这家餐厅附近停车方便，例如有可用的免费停车场。
evidence_span: parking was available in a nearby free parking lot
evidence_context:
But the friend banana was pretty close to what I have had elsewhere (except I never had friend banana with a splash of chocolate tlike this). 

As to other issues, here is the run down: parking was available in a nearby free parking lot; the wait service was friendly and service was quick; the atmosphere was perfect for quiet two-person conversation and large group atmosphere; and the prices were moderate.

I highly recommend this restaurant.

query_text: 哪家餐馆周围车位多、停车不发愁？帮我找找看。
requirement_text: 评论应能证明该餐馆周边停车位充足、容易停车。
evidence_span: plenty of parking in the area!
evidence_context: Excellent burgers, drinks, and service. The rest of the menu looked awesome, too. Oh, and plenty of parking in the area! Check it out

query_text: 我开车去找吃的，想问问哪家餐厅停车省心、到了随便就能停好车？
requirement_text: 评论需要直接说明在这家餐厅附近停车是否顺利方便。
evidence_span: Cozy ambiance and amazing food but no parking.
evidence_context: Cozy ambiance and amazing food but no parking. Staff was very personable. Food was timely. It was a weeknight and not too busy. Check out my pics for details on the food:)

query_text: 打算开车去吃饭，想找个旁边好停车、不用为车位发愁的店，求推荐。
requirement_text: 评论应具体说明餐厅附近的停车情况是方便还是没有车位。
evidence_context: I went here for my birthday and made reservations a week in advance and still had to wait 1 and a half hours to be seated. It was cold and the waiting area was dirty. The food was cold as well. By the time we ordered there were barely any food options left and that was the kicker. There was no parking. Drinks were over priced. My server was nice though.
